note: Softmax@V with a symbolic sequence length on the Hopper warp-group cell: the probabilities arrive as a stored input, so the chunk tier gathers its score fragments and the warp-group expectation reads the value through a descriptor. The carrier has no query, so there is no query slab to fill ahead of the chunk loop; the lowering asked for one and failed. The query rows stay symbolic, so the 64-row tile overhangs them.
